system.creatureSubtype: immune to poison, Poisoned, Frightened; resistant to fire (+2 DR
system.tactics: Nightmares are mounts first and combatants second. In combat without a rider, they rear and strike with their hooves, using their speed to break through formations. As a summoner's mount they are exceptional — fast, terrifying, and capable of brief planar transit. A Cooperative Nightmare will carry the summoner wherever they indicate; an Indifferent one runs toward whatever frightens it least and expects to be chased.
system.attacksNotes:
Flaming Hooves [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 8 + Melee Combat 3), Reach: 5 ft

  • Margin 1:: 11 damage (6 + 5 Str) + 3 fire damage (Half DR).
  • Margin 2: 11 damage, DR halved (round up) + 3 fire damage; target knocked Prone.
  • Margin 3: 11 damage, DR halved (round up) + 3 fire damage; target Prone and Stunned until end of their next turn.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Shadow Stride (1/day): The Nightmare can carry up to 3 riders into the Shadow Plane for up to 1 hour, moving through solid objects during transit. It must return to the material plane within the duration or the effect ends suddenly and all passengers are ejected. Smoke: The Nightmare's flaming hooves generate a thick smoke trail when running at full speed (40+ feet moved in a turn). The trail persists for 1 minute and creates a 10-foot-wide path of Difficult Terrain and heavy obscurement. Terror Mount: A rider on a Nightmare adds 2 to both dice on Intimidate checks while mounted.
